purpose.text: Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and Google's Indexing API to analyze website traffic, content, audiences, engagement, conversions, revenue, and search performance, compare periods, monitor real-time activity, inspect URL index status, and submit indexing notifications. Save analysis results and produce human-readable summaries.

evidences.reason: The skill description states the services and the website analysis and indexing purposes.
The workflow defines analysis, result storage, and summary creation.
The indexing reference describes re-crawl, removal, and inspection operations.
